texts.en:
Before a £minerals£ Mineral deposit or a Strategic Resource can be collected from a £planet£ Planet, a £mining_station£ Mining Station needs to be built in orbit. To do this, select your £construction_ship£ Construction Ship either by clicking directly on it or by finding it in the Outliner on the right side of the screen.

Once this has been done, click on the [GetBuildGrowCap] Mining Station button in the Construction Ship's fleet interface. Then click on an available planet or asteroid with a Mineral deposit.

Note that building a £mining_station£ Mining Station also costs £minerals£ Minerals, so you will need to have a sufficient amount stored before construction can begin.
